rejected_rule.statement: The owner of an undivided share of land may sue a trespasser to have their title declared and for ejectment from the whole land.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: As regards the rights of owners of undivided shares of land to sue trespassers, I have always understood the law, both before and after the coming into operation of the Civil Procedure Code, to be that the owner of an undivided share of land might sue a trespasser to have his title to the undivided share declared and for ejectment of the trespasser from the whole land.

meta.parties: Hevawitarane Et Al. v. Dangan Rubber Co.,Ltd
